heading.en: How does a storm lift a roof?

hook.en: In a strong storm, tin roofs fly off even though the wind blows sideways. Fast-moving air above the roof has lower pressure than the still air below it.
hook.kn: ಬಿರುಗಾಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಗಾಳಿ ಪಕ್ಕಕ್ಕೆ ಬೀಸಿದರೂ ತಗಡಿನ ಛಾವಣಿಗಳು ಹಾರಿಹೋಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಛಾವಣಿಯ ಮೇಲಿನ ವೇಗದ ಗಾಳಿಯ ಒತ್ತಡ ಕೆಳಗಿನ ನಿಶ್ಚಲ ಗಾಳಿಗಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆ.

objectives.en: Explain the venturimeter and dynamic lift

narration.en: In a strong storm, tin roofs fly off even though the wind blows sideways. Fast-moving air above the roof has lower pressure than the still air below it.
narration.kn: ಬಿರುಗಾಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಗಾಳಿ ಪಕ್ಕಕ್ಕೆ ಬೀಸಿದರೂ ತಗಡಿನ ಛಾವಣಿಗಳು ಹಾರಿಹೋಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಛಾವಣಿಯ ಮೇಲಿನ ವೇಗದ ಗಾಳಿಯ ಒತ್ತಡ ಕೆಳಗಿನ ನಿಶ್ಚಲ ಗಾಳಿಗಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆ.

body.en: For steady flow of an incompressible, non-viscous fluid, along a streamline P + ½ρv² + ρgh = constant. It is the work–energy theorem for a fluid: pressure energy, kinetic energy and potential energy per unit volume add to a constant. Where the fluid moves faster, its pressure is lower.
body.kn: ಸ್ಥಿರ, ಅಸಂಪೀಡ್ಯ, ಸ್ನಿಗ್ಧತೆಯಿಲ್ಲದ ಹರಿವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಧಾರಾರೇಖೆಯುದ್ದಕ್ಕೂ P + ½ρv² + ρgh ಸ್ಥಿರ. ಇದು ಶಕ್ತಿಯ ಸಂರಕ್ಷಣೆ. ವೇಗ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾದಲ್ಲಿ ಒತ್ತಡ ಕಡಿಮೆ.

say.en: A liquid flows along a pipe that rises and narrows. At section 1 it has pressure P₁, speed v₁, height h₁; at 2, P₂, v₂, h₂.
The work done by the pressure difference on a volume ΔV equals its gain in kinetic and potential energy.
Rearranging: pressure energy plus kinetic energy plus potential energy per unit volume is constant along a streamline.
Speed of efflux: a hole at depth h below the open surface. Pressure is Pₐ on both sides, so the liquid leaves at root 2 g h. For h = 5 metres, about 9.9 metres per second.
Dynamic lift: air flows faster over the curved top of a wing, so the pressure above is lower. A 30 metre per second wind over a roof lowers the pressure by about 540 pascal.

narration.en: A liquid flows along a pipe that rises and narrows. At section 1 it has pressure P₁, speed v₁, height h₁; at 2, P₂, v₂, h₂. The work done by the pressure difference on a volume ΔV equals its gain in kinetic and potential energy. Rearranging: pressure energy plus kinetic energy plus potential energy per unit volume is constant along a streamline. Speed of efflux: a hole at depth h below the open surface. Pressure is Pₐ on both sides, so the liquid leaves at root 2 g h. For h = 5 metres, about 9.9 metres per second. Dynamic lift: air flows faster over the curved top of a wing, so the pressure above is lower. A 30 metre per second wind over a roof lowers the pressure by about 540 pascal.

Bernoulli's equation between the water surface and the hole gives the speed of efflux v = √(2gh), the speed of a body falling through h (Torricelli's law). As the tank empties h falls, so the jet slows and lands closer. The jet lands at a distance 2√(h y), where y is the height of the hole above the ground.
narration.kn: ನೀರಿನ ಮೇಲ್ಮೈ ಮತ್ತು ರಂಧ್ರದ ನಡುವೆ ಬರ್ನೌಲಿ ಸಮೀಕರಣ ಹೊರಹರಿವಿನ ವೇಗ v = √(2gh) ಕೊಡುತ್ತದೆ (ಟೊರಿಸೆಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಯಮ). ತೊಟ್ಟಿ ಖಾಲಿಯಾದಂತೆ h ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಗಿ ಚಿಮ್ಮು ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ಹತ್ತಿರ ಬೀಳುತ್ತದೆ. ಚಿಮ್ಮು 2√(h y) ದೂರದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೀಳುತ್ತದೆ; y ರಂಧ್ರದ ನೆಲದಿಂದ ಎತ್ತರ.

body.en: Speed of efflux (Torricelli's law): liquid leaves a hole at depth h below the open surface with v = √(2gh), the speed of a body falling freely through h. A venturimeter measures flow speed from the pressure drop in a narrow throat. Dynamic lift on an aeroplane wing (aerofoil) and on a spinning ball (Magnus effect) comes from faster air, and so lower pressure, on one side.
body.kn: ಟೊರಿಸೆಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಯಮ: ಆಳ h ನಲ್ಲಿನ ರಂಧ್ರದಿಂದ ದ್ರವ v = √(2gh) ವೇಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊರಬರುತ್ತದೆ. ವೆಂಚುರಿಮೀಟರ್ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಮಾನದ ರೆಕ್ಕೆಯ ಮೇಲೆತ್ತುವ ಬಲ ಕೂಡ ಬರ್ನೌಲಿ ತತ್ವದ ಅನ್ವಯಗಳು.
